sections.caption: The cobogó wall, Rio.
sections.title: Cut for a wide back and four steady paws.
sections.body: The capybara never rushes. It waits for the sun, wades into the river and sits with the herd until evening. We make clothes for that life. Linen that dries on the bank. Raincoats that welcome the storm. Robes for the long soak with the yuzu floating by. Nothing is loud and nothing is hurried.

sections.title: Pup, Adult or Big Boss.
sections.body: Three sizes, graded from real body measurements. Measure around the widest part of the barrel, just behind the front legs. If girth and back disagree, girth wins.
